name: kickstart
description: Open files with configured programs without changing system associations

name: -v
--verbose
options.description: Show matching rules and exact launch arguments

options.name: --config
options.description: Use a specific config file instead of the default platform or XDG config

options.name: --program
options.description: Use a program once; quote commands containing arguments (conflicts with --with)

args.name: command
args.description: Executable or quoted command, for example 'code --wait'

options.name: --with
options.description: Select a named action from the config (conflicts with --program)

args.name: action
args.description: Action configured using extension:action or default:action rules

options.name: --terminal
options.description: Choose how to launch terminal applications (default: auto)

suggestions.name: auto
suggestions.description: Open recognized terminal programs in a new terminal

suggestions.name: current
suggestions.description: Run directly in the current terminal

suggestions.name: new
suggestions.description: Always launch in a new terminal

suggestions.name: gui
suggestions.description: Launch directly without wrapping in a terminal

options.name: --batch
options.description: Pass all selected files to one command; file mappings must agree

name: --dry-run
--explain
options.description: Show config, matching rules and exact argv without launching

options.name: --check-config
options.description: Validate all configured executables without opening files
Treat all remaining arguments as filenames, including names beginning with a dash

options.name: --gen-config
options.description: Create a sample at the preferred config path without overwriting existing files

options.name: --show-config-path
options.description: Print the config path selected for reading without creating files

args.name: file
args.description: One or more files to open
